verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one doc line saying AgentMail's hosted MCP server exposes 'calendar tools' (docs-54). Other versions of the same MCP page list no calendar tools at all, and nothing describes sharing availability or embedding bookable meeting slots in an email. Missing for 10: documented availability-sharing or booking-link insertion into messages, details of what the calendar tools do, consistent documentation, and hands-on corroboration.
